items.exampleEn: Though it was late, she was not tired.
items.exampleZh: 雖然已經很晚了，她卻不累。

items.exampleEn: My office is not far from here.
items.exampleZh: 我的辦公室離這裡不遠。

items.exampleEn: I have lived in Taipei since 2020.
items.exampleZh: 我從 2020 年起就住在台北。

items.exampleEn: She is the tallest among her friends.
Have you ever been to Japan?
I like this city. However, it is too noisy.
items.exampleZh: 我喜歡這座城市，不過它太吵了。

items.exampleEn: Please answer the email within two days.
items.exampleZh: 請在兩天內回覆這封電子郵件。
他自己一個人做了晚餐。

items.sentenceEn: Have you ever cooked dinner by yourself?
items.sentenceZh: 你曾經自己一個人煮過晚餐嗎？

items.audioEn: The station is not far. You can walk there within ten minutes.
items.audioZh: 車站不遠，你走路十分鐘內就能到。
items.questionZh: 走路到車站最多要多久？

items.sentenceEn: Though it was raining, we still went out.
items.sentenceZh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。

items.sentenceEn: Please call me back within an hour.
items.sentenceZh: 請在一小時內回我電話。

items.stemZh: 我從 2015 年起就認識 Amy 了。

items.stemEn: The food was good. ____, it was too expensive.
items.stemZh: 食物很好吃，不過太貴了。

items.passageEn: Ben's grandfather is eighty years old. Though he lives far from the city, he never feels lonely. He has lived in the same small village since 1970, and he knows everyone there. Among all his neighbors, he is the oldest. He still does everything himself. However, he does not drive anymore, so Ben visits him every Sunday.
items.passageZh: Ben 的爺爺八十歲了。雖然他住得離城市很遠，卻從不覺得寂寞。他從 1970 年起就住在同一個小村莊，認識那裡的每一個人。在所有鄰居當中，他年紀最大。他還是什麼事都自己做。不過他現在不開車了，所以 Ben 每個星期天都去看他。

questions.questionZh: Ben 為什麼每個星期天去看爺爺？

referenceEn: He lives very far from his office.
rubricZh: 用 far from 表示「離⋯很遠」（寫 far away from、a long way from 也正確）
動詞配合第三人稱單數（例如 lives）

items.promptZh: 這是我吃過最好吃的蛋糕。
referenceEn: This is the best cake I have ever eaten.
This is the best cake I've ever had.
rubricZh: 用 ever 搭配完成式表示「曾經」（例如 have ever eaten、I've ever had 等）
「最好吃的蛋糕」可寫，例如 the best cake、the most delicious cake 等
cake 後面可加 that，也可以省略

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["因此","反而","此外","然而"]（原 ["曾經","在⋯之內","在⋯之中","然而"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關："He lives far from his company." 中 company 指「公司（組織）」，far from his company 讀起來像離他自己開的公司很遠；表達通勤距離較自然是 far from his office／far from work。建議第一句改 office 或 work。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "He lives far from work."（原 "He lives far from his company."）
